title: Coordinate System
description: Unapproved planning coordinate authority with explicit axes, orientation, precision, transformations, and verification boundaries

source_refs.extraction_method: SHA-256 plus targeted structured/text extraction and manual reconciliation

source_refs.locator: Stage, pavilion, zones, and geometry source-family row
source_refs.extraction_method: SHA-256 plus targeted structured/text extraction and manual reconciliation

data.verification_boundary: All numeric and descriptive geometry is a prototype candidate. No value is surveyed, physically measured, venue-confirmed, structurally rated, load-approved, clearance-approved, or safe for execution.
data.use_rule: Planning and visualization only. Field measurement, venue confirmation, technical review, and applicable safety/engineering approval are required before construction, rigging, access, clearance, or cue use.

origin.definition: Stage centerline at rear edge of main deck

z.meaning: vertical height relative to main stage deck datum

precision.source_precision: preserve supplied decimal places; do not infer measurement tolerance
precision.display_rounding: must not imply greater accuracy than evidence

transformations.rotation: right-handed rotation in degrees; positive by right-hand rule; rotation order z,y,x when a compound transform is unavoidable
transformations.scale: prohibited for physical planning unless explicitly identified as visualization-only
transformations.unit_conversion: convert every component using the declared conversion factor
transformations.provenance_rule: derived coordinates must identify source coordinate, transform, and rounding

candidate_coordinate_policy.null_rule: unknown values remain null, never zero

unresolved_questions: Survey/field-measure the origin and deck datum.
Confirm orientation against venue and stage-management conventions.
Establish measurement tolerance and survey control points.
